1.t: When the Event (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) befalls.

2.t: And there can be no denial of its befalling.

3.t: Bringing low (some - those who will enter Hell) Exalting (others - those who will enter Paradise). [Tafsir Ibn Kathir]

4.t: When the earth will be shaken with a terrible shake.

5.t: And the mountains will be powdered to dust,

6.t: So that they will become floating dust particles.

7.t: And you (all) will be in three groups.

8.t: So those on the Right Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Records in their right hands) - how (fortunate) will be those on the Right Hand! (As a respect for them, because they will enter Paradise).

9.t: And those on the Left Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Record in their left hands) - how (unfortunate) will be those on the Left Hand! (As a disgrace for them, because they will enter Hell).

10.t: And those foremost [(in Islâmic Faith of Monotheism and in performing righteous deeds) in the life of this world on the very first call for to embrace Islâm] will be foremost (in Paradise).

11.t: These will be the nearest (to Allâh).

13.t: A multitude of those (foremost) will be from the first generations (who embraced Islâm).

14.t: And a few of those (foremost) will be from the later generations.

15.t: (They will be) on thrones woven with gold and precious stones.

17.t: Immortal boys will go around them (serving),

18.t: With cups, and jugs, and a glass of flowing wine,

19.t: Wherefrom they will get neither any aching of the head, nor any intoxication.

20.t: And with fruit that they may choose.

21.t: And with the flesh of fowls that they desire.

22.t: And (there will be) Hûr (fair females) with wide, lovely eyes (as wives for "Al-Muttaqûn" - the pious - See V. 2:2),

24.t: A reward for what they used to do.

25.t: No Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk) will they hear therein, nor any sinful speech (like backbiting).

26.t: But only the saying of: Salâm! Salâm! (greetings with peace)!

27.t: And those on the Right Hand - how (fortunate) will be those on the Right Hand?

29.t: And among Talh (banana-trees) with fruits piled one above another,

33.t: Whose supply is not cut off (by change of season), nor are they out of reach,

34.t: And on couches or thrones, raised high.

35.t: Verily, We have created them (maidens) of special creation.

37.t: Loving (their husbands only), (and) of equal age.

38.t: For those on the Right Hand.

39.t: A multitude of those (on the Right Hand) will be from the first generation (who embraced Islâm).

40.t: And a multitude of those (on the Right Hand) will be from the later generations.

41.t: And those on the Left Hand - how (unfortunate) will be those on the Left Hand?

42.t: In fierce hot wind and boiling water,

45.t: Verily, before that, they indulged in luxury,

46.t: And were persisting in great sin (joining partners in worship along with Allâh, committing murder and other crimes)

47.t: And they used to say: "When we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be resurrected?

49.t: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "(Yes) verily, those of old, and those of later times.

50.t: "All will surely be gathered together for appointed Meeting of a known Day.

51.t: "Then moreover, verily you the erring-ones, the deniers (of Resurrection)!

52.t: "You verily will eat of the trees of Zaqqûm.

53.t: "Then you will fill your bellies therewith,

54.t: "And drink boiling water on top of it.

55.t: "And you will drink (that) like thirsty camels!"

56.t: That will be their entertainment on the Day of Recompense!

57.t: We created you: then why do you believe not?

58.t: Then tell Me (about) the (human) semen that you emit.

59.t: Is it you who create it (i.e. make this semen into a perfect human being), or are We the Creator?

60.t: We have decreed death to you all, and We are not outstripped,

61.t: To transfigure you and create you in (forms) that you know not.

62.t: And indeed, you have already known the first form of creation (i.e. the creation of Adam): why then do you not remember (or take heed)?

63.t: Then tell Me about the seed that you sow in the ground.

64.t: Is it you that make it grow, or are We the Grower?

65.t: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry pieces, and you would be regretful (or left in wonderment) [Tafsir Ibn Kathîr].

66.t: (Saying): "We are indeed Mughramûn (i.e. ruined or have lost the money without any profit, or are punished by the loss of all that we spend for cultivation)! (Tafsir Al-Qurtubî)

68.t: Then tell Me about the water that you drink.

69.t: Is it you who cause it from the rain-clouds to come down, or are We the Causer of it to come down?

70.t: If We willed, We verily could make it salt (and undrinkable): why then do you not give thanks (to Allâh)?

71.t: Then tell Me about the fire which you kindle.

72.t: Is it you who made the tree thereof to grow, or are We the Grower?

73.t: We have made it a Reminder (of the Hell-fire in the Hereafter), and an article of use for the travellers (and all the others, in this world).

74.t: Then glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.

75.t: So I swear by the setting of the stars.

75.fn: In Arabic Mawâqi‘i An-Nujûm: This word has many interpretations: it may mean the setting or the rising or the mansions of the stars, or the Qur’ân and its gradual revelation in stages. Please see Tafsir At-Tabari for detail..

76.t: And verily that is indeed a great oath, if you but know.

77.t: That (this) is indeed an honourable recitation (the Noble Qur’ân).

78.t: In a Book well-guarded (with Allâh in the heaven i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz ).

79.t: Which (that Book with Allâh) none can touch but the purified (i.e. the angels).

80.t: A Revelation (this Qur’ân) from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

81.t: Is it such a talk (this Qur’ân) that you (disbelievers) deny?

82.t: And instead (of thanking Allâh) for the provision He gives you, you deny (Him by disbelief)!

83.t: Then why do you not (intervene) when (the soul of a dying person) reaches the throat?

84.t: And you at the moment are looking on,

85.t: But We (i.e. Our angels who take the soul) are nearer to him than you, but you see not, (Tafsir At-Tabarî)

86.t: Then why do you not - if you are exempt from the reckoning and recompense (punishment) -

87.t: Bring back the soul (to its body), if you are truthful?

88.t: Then, if he (the dying person) be of the Muqarrabûn (those brought near to Allâh),

89.t: (There is for him) rest and provision, and a Garden of Delights (Paradise).

90.t: And if he (the dying person) be of those on the Right Hand,

91.t: Then there is safety and peace (from the Punishment of Allâh) for those on the right Hand.

92.t: But if he (the dying person) be of the denying (of the Resurrection), the erring (away from the Right Path of Islâmic Monotheism),

93.t: Then for him is an entertainment with boiling water.

95.t: Verily, this! This is an absolute Truth with certainty.

96.t: So glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.
